_comment: Accepted deviations from the product data contract enforced by
tools/validate_products.py. Every entry is a finding the validator still
reports, tolerated because it predates the contract or needs an owner
decision. Entries marked UNRESOLVED DEFECT are real data errors that have
not been fixed -- they are recorded so they stay visible, not excused.
New product data must pass the contract outright and must not be added here.
Regenerate the report with: python3 tools/validate_products.py --show-known
An entry whose finding ends in '*' matches by prefix, for findings carrying a measured value that varies between runs.

UNRESOLVED DEFECT, TWO FAULTS. (1) The simulation calls np.random.normal with no seed, so it is not reproducible and cannot serve as evidence. (2) The HbA1c estimate sits on its own 0.5% spec limit: measured 2026-08-08 over 8 runs the mean error ranged 0.409%-0.643% and the script exited non-zero 4 times out of 8. Baselined by prefix because the reported figure changes every run. NOT fixed here: seeding the RNG to a value that happens to pass would weaken the check rather than address the marginal design.
